name: Curt Bergfors Food Planet Prize (Curt Bergfors Foundation)
collect_note: Page watch only. The Food Planet Prize has no call for proposals and no deadline-bearing call page: it is an annual award that takes nominations through a form open year-round (the page advises nominating before May for the following year's cycle, which is guidance, not a dated call). The prize page is watched twice a day and any text change (for example a new cycle, longlist or shortlist wording) changes the content hash and is flagged. The nomination form itself is not a call and is not collected.
